article.story: CHARLOTTE, N.C. -- — Carson Schwieger had 29 points in Queens' 91-72 win over North Florida on Saturday. Schwieger went 10 of 13 from the field (7 for 10 from 3-point range) for the Royals (14-11, 9-3 Atlantic Sun Conference). Jordan Watford scored 12 points and added seven rebounds. Yoav Berman shot 5 for 12 to finish with 12 points, while adding six assists. The Ospreys (6-19, 4-8) were led in scoring by Mason Lee, who finished with 16 points and six rebounds. North Florida also got 15 points from Kamrin Oriol. Nestor Dyachok finished with 12 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
